key_insight: LCatlas is a web-based tool that uses routine patient data to predict first-line immunotherapy outcomes in non-small cell lung cancer, rather than discover new drugs.
clinical_relevance: The tool could support research-informed treatment discussions about immunotherapy alone or with chemotherapy, but clinical utility remains to be established.
method: Extracted demographic, clinical, and molecular features from records of 79 patients.
Compared logistic regression, XGBoost, and TabTransformer models.
Used nine input categories, including metastatic sites, PD-L1 staining, and routine blood measurements.
evidence_signal: Reported cross-validation AUC was 0.79 [0.72–0.85], with 87% sensitivity and 78% specificity; accuracy was 82% in a separate 28-person validation cohort.
watch_item: Small development and validation cohorts limit confidence in generalizability; broader prospective validation is needed before routine clinical use.
paper_title: LCatlas: A Point-Of-Care Tool for Predicting Immunotherapy Outcomes in Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
